{"ascii":"Runtime Composition and APIs
|-- [M] Composition boundary: createBackend chooses and connects concrete integrations
|   |-- Exposes routes.core, routes.mapping, liveCanvas, diffSessionWorkflows,
|   |   pushIntegrations and dispose(); other collaborators stay behind these handles
|   |-- Route factories receive application services; stores and runtimes are wired here
|   `-- Architecture tests constrain dependencies
|       |-- Application -> application + domain; domain -> domain
|       |-- Infrastructure -> infrastructure + application + domain
|       |-- Server -> server + application + domain; bootstrap may also use infrastructure
|       |-- UI -> UI + domain + packages
|       `-- Outside composition, imports target non-composition code in core or the same owner
|-- [C] Vite configuration -> diagramApi(...) -> createBackend(...)
|   |-- Project/storage roots and domain profile configure the backend
|   |   `-- Watcher excludes application storage so record writes do not trigger reloads
|   |-- HTTP, AI and LSP flags are independent; each requires explicit true
|   |   |-- HTTP flag controls the transport gates below
|   |   |-- AI flag is passed to production model integrations and push/diff workflows
|   |   `-- LSP flag determines whether ProjectLanguageService is constructed
|   `-- NEW_DIAGRAM_AGENT=fake substitutes local-chat, selection, diagram-edit,
|       compaction, evaluation and comparison runtimes
|       `-- Agent chat still gets StdioCodexConnection; diff workflows still get Pi runtime
|-- Shared integrations constructed once per backend
|   |-- [O] DiagramStore anchors durable repositories under its storeRoot
|   |   |-- Core/source services receive store + corpus access; source also gets optional LSP
|   |   `-- Mapping services receive file/JSON repositories for their respective records
|   |-- Context library and diagram-context store share FileAgentContextSources
|   |   `-- [D] sourceId -> corpus backing
|   |       |-- repo-* -> resolved repository checkout root
|   |       `-- Other IDs -> initialized project + resolved source binding
|   |           `-- Missing project -> AGENT_CONTEXT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE
|   |-- GenerationCanvasBridge wraps the browser CanvasSessionBridge
|   |   |-- Injected into live-canvas callbacks, agent sessions, changes and agent chat
|   |   `-- Live context callback dispatches workspaceInstanceId + documentId to the bridge
|   |-- One CanvasApiProjection and one AgentContextService
|   |   `-- Both injected into LiveCanvasService and AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|   |       `-- This composition establishes shared instances across those two services
|   |-- AgentChatService receives live canvas, context library and the shared bridge
|   |   `-- ChatDiagramTools and MappingChatMcpBinding both target the same agent service
|   `-- PushIntegrationService receives GitPushSource + DiffSessionWorkflowService
|       `-- Diff workflow receives the shared change-session and agent services
|-- Evaluation integration: construction, later assignment and callbacks are distinct
|   |-- EvalRunService constructor receives comparison/workspace services, context library,
|   |   prompts, generated-canvas catalog, stores and the selected evaluation runtime
|   |-- Bootstrap then assigns layoutTemplates, histories, referenceGenerations,
|   |   judgements and experiments as collaborators on evalRuns
|   |   `-- Judgements also receive comparison generation and shared comparison/eval stores
|   `-- Callback contracts connect services after construction
|       |-- Chat generation observations (children, parent, historical) -> recordLegacy(...)
|       |   `-- Observation promise rejection is logged; bootstrap does not await it
|       |-- Catalog snapshot(id, checkpoint) -> evalRuns.outputSnapshot(id, checkpoint)
|       `-- Eval replay/cancel -> agent chat; change lookup -> changes;
|           context-comparison deletion -> comparison generation
|-- [C] Same attachment function serves Vite development and preview
|   |-- Install HTTP middleware; attach live-canvas sockets when httpServer exists
|   |   `-- Socket context uploads and canvas writes each require HTTP flag true
|   |-- Request outside /api and /internal -> next middleware
|   |-- Classified agent mutation + HTTP flag off + no x-canvas-chat-binding header
|   |   `-- Return 403 HTTP_WRITES_DISABLED before namespace dispatch
|   |-- Dispatch only /api/<known namespace>/...; otherwise 404, including /internal
|   |   |-- core -> project source/definitions, catalog and representations
|   |   `-- mapping -> diagrams/workspace, agents/chat, changes/push, comparisons/evaluations
|   |       `-- Delegated optional route groups require their services; bootstrap supplies them
|   |-- Streaming selection: prepare input -> flush NDJSON headers -> run with progress
|   |   `-- Emit result and end response if execution succeeds
|   `-- Exceptions from dispatched routes -> transport error translation
|       |-- Before headers: JSON status for size (413), conflict (409), binary source (415),
|       |   unavailable AI/LSP/storage (503), or invalid input/other errors (400)
|       `-- After headers: emit error event, then end if response remains writable
`-- [O] Adapter owns transport-linked cleanup
    |-- Definition request owns an AbortController and response-close listener
    |   `-- Premature close aborts work; finally removes listener; destroyed response gets no result
    `-- If httpServer exists, register its close listener
        |-- Dispose socket attachment, then call backend.dispose()
        `-- Backend invokes cleanup in order: comparisons -> evals -> agent chat -> diff workflows
            -> agent -> diagram-edit runtime -> canvas bridge -> optional LSP
            -> selection runtime -> local-chat runtime -> compaction
            `-- Sequential calls have no try/finally here; a throw can prevent later cleanup"}
